table.retrieve:
select  billno=SL.saleinvcode,
	date=max(SL.date),
	itemname=I.name,
	regno=max(P.regno),
	patientname=max(P.name),
	qty=sum(SD.looseqty),
	rate=SD.saleprice,
	amount=sum(SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice),
	id=max(SD.rowid),
	customer=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=max(P.custcode))
from 
	saleledger SL ,saledetail SD,item I,patient P
where  SL.date>=:ad_StartDate AND 
	SL.date<=:ad_EndDate AND
	SL.Patientcode=:ai_patientcode AND
	SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode AND
	SD.icode=I.icode AND
	P.patientcode=SL.patientcode 
GROUP By
	SL.date,
	SL.saleinvcode,
	SD.icode,
	I.name,
	SD.saleprice
ORDER BY
	P.Regno,
	SL.Date,
	SL.saleinvcode,
	id
/*	I.name*/
